# Buildings & Facades | PS1 Asset Packs

Source: https://mcpato.itch.io/buildings-facades-ps1-asset-packs

Downloaded 2026-10-22: DoriHome2.fbx. The original FBX is retained. Embedded textures were extracted without pixel modifications. Unity import settings, generated lightmap UVs, URP materials, scene scale and placement were adapted for the ProjectCRT outdoor lighting test. Roads, bar entrance dressing and lighting added by ProjectCRT are separate scene additions.

Retain author, source, license and modification notice in distributed credits.
